scripts.build: node --check server.js && node --check app.js && node --check tasks.js && node --check task-title.js && node --check task-actions.js && node --check task-filter.js && node --check storage.js && node --check dom.js
scripts.score: node --input-type=module -e "import { getTaskScore } from './tasks.js'; const result = getTaskScore(); console.log('Score: ' + result.score + '/' + result.total); for (const check of result.checks) console.log((check.passed ? 'PASS: ' : 'FIX: ') + check.name);"
